canonical_statement: Viable cosmological models must demonstrate global consistency across multiple observational probes, including expansion history, present-day structure growth amplitude, and its redshift-dependence.

attributions.surface_quote: viable cosmological models must satisfy global consistency across multiple probes

canonical_statement: In modified-gravity scenarios, the present-day amplitude of structure growth and its evolution with redshift are distinct and independently constrained by theory.

attributions.surface_quote: in modified-gravity scenarios...present-day amplitude of growth and its evolution with redshift respond differently

canonical_statement: Cosmological tensions are not isolated issues but interconnected constraints within the framework of cosmic models.

attributions.surface_quote: Cosmological tensions are not independent problems but interconnected constraints.

canonical_statement: Viable cosmological models must satisfy a consistency triangle involving expansion history, growth amplitude, and growth shape.

attributions.surface_quote: viable models must satisfy a consistency triangle involving: Expansion history; Growth amplitude; Growth shape
